name: Serengeti & Zanzibar
about: Two wildlife peaks: the Jan–Mar Ndutu calving season and the Jun–Oct dry-season migration. Long rains hit Mar–May.
overview: Two of East Africa's signature trips in one — big-cat drama on the Serengeti's plains, then a slower stretch on Zanzibar's Swahili coast.
costOverview: Most of the cost comes down to the camp or lodge tier, which bundles the guide, vehicle, and meals, plus park and conservation fees which are high compared to other African safari destinations.

specialSeasons.text: Huge herds gather on the Ndutu plains for calving season, drawing large numbers of predators.
The Great Migration herds move north through the Serengeti now, including dramatic river crossings.
